title: Bengaluru-based Pronto, which offers on-demand home-help services like cooking and cleaning, raised a $25M Series B led by Epiq Capital at a $100M valuation (Sankalp Phartiyal/Bloomberg)
summary: Sankalp Phartiyal / Bloomberg: Bengaluru-based Pronto, which offers on-demand home-help services like cooking and cleaning, raised a $25M Series B led by Epiq Capital at a $100M valuation — Household-help app Pronto raised funding at a $100 million valuation, underscoring rising demand for services such as cooking …
